_readme: agents_v2 role -> model routing. Wire format: OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions on cleanapis.com/v1.
SECURITY: no keys here, ever. The key lives ONLY in GitHub Secrets (CLEANAPIS) and enters via env CLEANAPIS_KEY inside Actions.
PRICES: usd_per_1m_input prefilled from the owner-scraped CLEANAPIS_CATALOG (config.py, scraped Sep 2026). usd_per_1m_output is unknown -> null.
price_confirmed_by_owner=false means: treat every USD number as UNCONFIRMED. Until the owner sets it true and fills output prices, cost is NOT estimated - the token counter is the only meter.
Candidate lists feed the model-fit-check workflow (PR ب2). The chosen 'model' per role is provisional until its results arrive.

Fit results from run 36932706713 (2026-10-01): all 12 candidates passed 10/10 on every item -> all eligible. Chosen per-role models are fit_verified=true. Prices remain UNCONFIRMED by owner: USD figures are input-price floors only.

caps._note: Owner fills numeric caps; null = unset. RUN_COST_CAP_USD (default 5.00) is the eval/fit-run USD ceiling used by the agents-v2-eval workflow; the USD number is an input-price FLOOR because output prices are unconfirmed. The code enforces whatever is set and raises BudgetExceeded when a cap is hit.

fit_results.acceptance_rule: ORCH/WORK eligible iff tool_call>=9/10 AND two_step>=8/10 (owner rule)
fit_results.note: model field = the id ECHOED BY THE PROVIDER; no claims beyond it. /v1/models names line failed (30s timeout) in this run — script fixed (90s + 3 retries); a cheap probe re-run captures the names line.
